tooltips.metaCapiEventName: Event name sent to Meta when an Opportunity ENTERS this stage. E.g. Lead, MQL, SQL, Purchase. Leave empty to not fire.
tooltips.metaCapiEventNameOnLeave: Optional: event fired when an Opportunity LEAVES this stage. Useful for marking step completion or Closed Lost.
tooltips.metaCapiActive: Read-only. True when the parent Funnel has metaCapiEnabled=true AND a linked active MetaCapiDataset. Maintained automatically; do not edit. Drives visibility of the Meta Conversions API section.
